title: NPC Dialogue Configuration
description: Single-NPC conversation profile for a Sauti-driven character. Defines persona, voice, knowledge tag, and behaviour. Templates of this shape pair an LLM persona with an RAG knowledge slice so the NPC speaks consistently and in-world.

templateId.description: Stable identifier for this template shape. Do not change.

description.description: Free-text note about what this concrete NPC is for. Not sent to the LLM.

npcId.description: Stable identifier the game uses to reference this NPC.

displayName.description: Player-facing name. May be shown in subtitles.

summary.description: One-paragraph who-they-are. Speaks in third person.

tone.description: Speech tone: e.g. 'warm grandmother', 'gruff sergeant', 'wry merchant'.

speechQuirks.description: Up to 5 short verbal mannerisms. Avoid markdown — these become LLM system-prompt bullets.

knowledgeTag.description: Tag to filter knowledge-base chunks by. Empty string = retrieve from any chunk.

promptRules.description: Voice-output constraints. Must mirror voice_ai_architecture.md § 9. Values are merged into the LLM system prompt at runtime.

examples.description: Example: Elder Maren, sage of the Crystal Caverns.

persona.summary: An elderly seer who has guarded the Crystal Caverns for sixty winters and only speaks after sundown.
